what_this_is: A ZZ DEMO pair of quotations that genuinely cannot be compared, kept so the refusal can be replayed by a human or by the nightly journey without inventing one at the time. Nothing here can reach a real person: both suppliers are ZZ DEMO and both addresses are @example.invalid.
why_this_pair_is_not_comparable: Supplier A prices SUPPLY ONLY of 120 m2 of flooring material for a villa in Al Barsha. Supplier B prices SUPPLY AND INSTALLATION of 300 m2 on a different site, and states no rate per m2. There is no common basis: neither the scope (supply vs supply-and-install), nor the area (120 vs 300 m2), nor the unit (rate vs lump sum) can be reconciled. A cheaper headline number here is not a better quote, it is different work.
the_failure_this_guards_against: A model that constructs a common basis anyway and ranks them. That reads as a helpful answer and is a wrong recommendation the customer pays 3% to act on.

inquiry.reference: ZZ DEMO — flooring, Al Barsha villa
inquiry.brief: Supply of porcelain floor tiles for a villa ground floor, approximately 120 m2. Material only; our own contractor lays them.

quotes.label: Supplier A
quotes.scope: Supply only of porcelain floor tile 600x600 matt, 120 m2 delivered to site. Installation, screed, adhesive and skirting are NOT included.

quotes.label: Supplier B
quotes.scope: Supply and full installation of porcelain flooring to the first floor of a commercial unit, approximately 300 m2, including screed levelling, adhesive, grouting and skirting. Lump sum; no rate per m2 stated.
